text:
incident-bot: ALERT: eval-gate-prod triggered for project=checkout-service. Gate=prompt-eval-output-drift (threshold 0.18) and safety-rule 'forbidden-entities' tripped. PagerDuty page fired.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page #PD-74312 fired -> escalation: oncall@redwood (primary: Alex Chen).

Alex Chen: ack'ing oncall. seeing the alert, joining. can someone paste the eval summary? :wave:

Marta Ruiz: pasting quick snapshot from the evaluator ingest:```
metric: output_drift_score=0.24 (threshold 0.18)
failed_examples=19/250
safety_regressions=6 (forbidden-entities triggered)
triggered_promptset="checkout_flow_v2"
model: rwd-model-v4.1-promote
```

Priya Nair: omg that's our promoted model from last night. Did the rollout ran to prod?

Sasha Lee: yes, automated canary finished and auto-promoted at 03:12 UTC per rollout logs. I see increased hallucination-type tokens in the eval diff.

Jamal Ortiz: support pinged 2 enterprise customers about weird pricing suggestions in checkout. They opened tickets ~03:25 UTC. linking ticket IDs in case triage needs them: TKT-8813, TKT-8817.

Alex Chen: ok first triage: impact = degraded quality (non-availability). Customers see incorrect pricing text in 2 known customers, potential wider exposure. No PII leak. Escalation to SE/Account execs needed.

Marta Ruiz: mitigation options: 1) rollback model to rwd-model-v3.9-stable 2) disable auto-promote and pin to v3.9 3) apply eval-gate temporary block to rollout pipeline 4) enable on-the-fly reroute to fallback-model small-latency (cheaper/older).

Priya Nair: recommend immediate rollback + gate block. We should also pause any pending canaries. I'll coordinate with release infra to abort promotions.

Sasha Lee: executing abort now. command:```sh
releasectl abort-promotion --model rwd-model-v4.1-promote --env prod || true
releasectl deploy --model rwd-model-v3.9-stable --env prod --scope canary:0-100
```

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page #PD-74312 acknowledged by Alex Chen at 2026-03-14T03:33:05Z.

Alex Chen: ack. Marta, can you start rollback and confirm token usage/latency impact? Sasha/Jamal, please craft a short status for support and account teams. Priya, hold promos and flip eval-gate to block for auto-promote.

Marta Ruiz: rolling back now. ETA ~6 min to complete + propagation checks. I'll post logs when done.

Support Team Bot: Notifying affected customers: template used -> "We're aware of an issue impacting checkout suggestions. We're rolling back a recent model change and will follow up within 30 minutes." (Sent to TKT-8813, TKT-8817)

Jamal Ortiz: drafting note to accounts: "We observed a model quality regression after an automated promotion. We're rolling back to the previous stable model and proactively reviewing evaluation thresholds. No customer data exposure. We'll follow up with incident postmortem"

Priya Nair: flipped eval-gate policy to BLOCK_AUTOPROMOTE for model-promotions in production:```yaml
eval_gate: 
  mode: BLOCK_AUTOPROMOTE
  gate_ids: [prompt-eval-output-drift, safety-rule-forbidden-entities]
```

Marta Ruiz: rollback finished. health checks: generation latency +2ms, error rate unchanged, sample checks passed for checkout prompts. Verified traffic now hitting rwd-model-v3.9-stable.

Alex Chen: good. marking as mitigated for now. leaving page open for 30m to monitor. Priya, can you open a postmortem ticket and assign owners? Include eval set, sample diffs, and timeline.

Priya Nair: creating postmortem: PM-2026-0314-eval-regression, assigning to Marta (lead), Sasha (release), Jamal (customer comms). Adding artifacts: eval snapshots, rollout logs, support tickets.

Sasha Lee: quick note: discovered a config change in promotion rules that loosened the safety gate thresholds for v4.x. adding to root cause list.

Jamal Ortiz: Customer updates posted. two customers replied acknowledging rollback and asked for follow-up call. I've scheduled calls with account teams.

Alex Chen: on-call handoff at 04:00 UTC -> Priya will take over monitoring. I'll stay in loop for exec comms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page #PD-74312 auto-escalation suspended (status: acknowledged).

incident-bot: NOTE: incident created: INC-2026-0314-02 (severity: medium, impact: quality/regression). Triage board link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0314-02

Priya Nair: I'll run a deeper eval diff against RQ and safety suite and update in 20m with RCA hypothesis. Leaving monitoring alerts at stricter sensitivity for next 24h.

Marta Ruiz: watchlist added: promptset=checkout_flow_v2, eval_gate=prompt-eval-output-drift, models=[rwd-model-v4.1-promote].

Alex Chen: agreed. closing non-essential notifications. thanks everyone for quick response.
